note: Unofficial English names and text for cards that were never printed in English (FC01, BT11-055 and PR cards; user's request, 2026-10-30). Used only when a card has no official English record; the game marks them as unofficial translations. Text follows the official English templates of the time (Nov 2014); the official Japanese text stays canonical.

FC01-001.name: Mighty Spear Liberator, Bleoberis
FC01-001.text:
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):[Counter-Blast 1] When a <Gold Paladin> rides this unit, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, search for up to two <Gold Paladin> from among them, call them to separate open (RC), put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order, choose one of your vanguards, and that unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a clan in common with this unit, this unit cannot attack)

FC01-003.name: Eradicator, Electric Shaper Dragon
FC01-003.text:
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):When a <Narukami> rides this unit, choose one of your vanguards, and until end of turn, that unit gets [Power] +10000 and "[AUTO](VC):When your opponent's rear-guard is put into the drop zone due to an effect from one of your cards, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the back row of the same column as the (RC) that card was on, and retire it.".
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if your opponent has three or more cards in his or her damage zone, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a clan in common with this unit, this unit cannot attack)

FC01-004.name: Story Teller
FC01-004.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):[Counter-Blast 2] When this unit's attack hits, if you have a <Dark Irregulars> vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.

FC01-007.name: Peerless Scribe, Ponga
FC01-007.text:
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if the [Power] of the unit it is battling is 12000 or greater, this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a <Great Nature> vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.

BT11-055.name: Hazard Bob
BT11-055.text: [AUTO]:[Counter-Blast 1] When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), if you have a <Genesis> vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your damage zone, and at the end of that turn, choose a card from your damage zone, return it to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
